title: Use a 9-grid storyboard to plan and keep 10+ connected scenes consistent across…
content:
Use a 9-grid storyboard to plan and keep 10+ connected scenes consistent across an AI film in Seedance 25  
Map camera movement in a 3D Director Stage before generating scenes to maintain consistent camera language across shots  
Plan the world (locations/props/style) upfront and build the story from that plan to maintain world consistency across multiple Seedance scenes
tips:

Map camera movement in a 3D Director Stage before generating scenes to maintain consistent camera language across shots  
Plan the world (locations/props/style) upfront and build the story from that plan to maintain world consistency across multiple Seedance scenes

es.content:
Usa un storyboard de 9 cuadrículas para planificar y mantener más de 10 escenas conectadas coherentes a lo largo de una película de IA en Seedance 25  
Mapea el movimiento de cámara en un 3D Director Stage antes de generar las escenas para mantener un lenguaje de cámara coherente entre planos  
Planifica el mundo (ubicaciones/props/estilo) desde el principio y construye la historia a partir de ese plan para mantener la coherencia del mundo en múltiples escenas de Seedance

fr.content:
Utilisez un storyboard en grille 9 pour planifier et maintenir la cohérence de 10 scènes connectées ou plus dans un film IA avec Seedance 25  
Cartographiez les mouvements de caméra sur une 3D Director Stage avant de générer les scènes afin de conserver un langage caméra cohérent d’un plan à l’autre  
Planifiez l’univers (lieux/objets/style) dès le départ et construisez l’histoire à partir de ce plan afin de maintenir la cohérence du monde à travers plusieurs scènes Seedance

ja.content:
Seedance 25 で、9分割のストーリーボードを使って、AI映画全体で10以上の連続したシーンの一貫性を保ちながら構成する  
シーン生成前に 3D Director Stage でカメラの動きをマッピングし、ショット全体で一貫したカメラ言語を維持する  
世界観（ロケーション／小道具／スタイル）を事前に設計し、そのプランをもとにストーリーを組み立てて、複数の Seedance シーンにわたる世界観の一貫性を保つ

ko.content:
Seedance 25에서 AI 영화 전반에 걸쳐 10개 이상의 연결된 장면을 일관되게 유지하려면 9-grid 스토리보드를 사용해 기획하세요  
장면을 생성하기 전에 3D Director Stage에서 카메라 움직임을 미리 설계해 샷 전반에 걸쳐 일관된 카메라 언어를 유지하세요  
세계관(로케이션/소품/스타일)을 사전에 기획하고 그 계획을 바탕으로 스토리를 구성해 여러 Seedance 장면에서 세계관의 일관성을 유지하세요

pt.content:
Use um storyboard em grade 3x3 para planejar e manter mais de 10 cenas conectadas consistentes ao longo de um filme de IA no Seedance 25  
Mapeie o movimento de câmera em um 3D Director Stage antes de gerar as cenas para manter uma linguagem de câmera consistente entre os takes  
Planeje o mundo (locais/props/estilo) com antecedência e construa a história a partir desse plano para manter a consistência do mundo em várias cenas do Seedance

zh.content:
使用 9 宫格 storyboard 来规划，并在 Seedance 25 的 AI 影片中保持 10+ 个连续场景的一致性  
在生成场景之前，先在 3D Director Stage 中规划 camera movement，以在不同镜头之间保持一致的 camera language  
提前规划世界观（locations/props/style），并基于该规划构建故事，以在多个 Seedance 场景中保持世界一致性
